retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait characterized by heavy motion blur and a grainy, dreamlike atmosphere.

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, high-contrast image of a person in a dynamic, tilted pose. The subject's features are softened by significant motion blur, creating a ghostly, ethereal effect. The image is defined by a heavy film grain texture and a stark interplay between deep blacks and bright, blown-out highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject tilted diagonally across the frame
Motion blur softening all edges and features
High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights
Heavy grain texture unifying the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally but tilted at a sharp diagonal, filling most of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, despite the blur, acts as the primary focal point in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the subject's body from the bottom left to the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, with the background appearing as a textured, hazy extension of the subject's motion.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays providing structure and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright, stark whites creating highlights and a sense of light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays blending the transition between light and shadow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic portrait with heavy motion blur and a tilted composition. Ensure the lighting creates deep shadows and bright highlights, and apply a dense film grain texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, thin-stroke sans-serif font with wide tracking to maintain the ethereal and airy feel of the background.

verificationChecks: Is there significant motion blur softening the subject?
Is the film grain texture prominent?
Is the contrast high with deep blacks and bright whites?

mustAchieve: A sense of movement and fluidity
avoid: Low-resolution artifacts instead of intentional grain

recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome + High Contrast + Motion Blur + Heavy Grain + Diagonal Composition = Ethereal Portrait
